cues: Hydrogen sulphide in alkaline solution gives white zinc sulphide, barium chloride gives white barium sulphate, and ferrocyanide a white precipitate.
White vitriol is used to make lithopone, a white pigment that does not blacken in polluted air, as an eye lotion, a mordant and a zinc fertiliser.
